short_description: Demons as SimpleITK's registration notebook runs it: fast symmetric forces, 20 iterations, the field smoothed with a standard deviation of 2, two coarse levels then full resolution, histogram matching first for MR. One modality only. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline demons.
description: Demons as SimpleITK's registration notebook runs it: fast symmetric forces, 20 iterations, the field smoothed with a standard deviation of 2, two coarse levels then full resolution, histogram matching first for MR. One modality only. The ImagingBenchmarks baseline demons. The pair must be aligned (rigidly for one patient, by an affine transform between two subjects): only the deformable stage runs. SimpleITK (CPU). Output: the displacement field on the fixed grid, in mm along the world axes (ITK, LPS).
